Avery — summary below and I attached the SOC2 extract.

StreamLog Ltd. (ingestion/logs):
- Receives anonymized request metadata and structured telemetry only (no customer-provided prompt/response payloads). We redact any user-identifying fields at ingress (customer tenant id, user email) before forwarding.
- Hosted in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 (primary + DR). No US hosting for the logging tier.
- StreamLog maintains its own subprocessors; we have the latest attestation from them and I can pull their subprocessor list.

TIA evidence pointers (for the Globemed template):
- Logs retention: default retention 30 days for detailed logs, aggregated metrics retained 365 days.
- KV cache: cache keys are tenant-scoped; we do not persist prompt text in KV; backups encrypted with customer key (KMS).
- Routing proof: we have routing logs (internal) that show request egress region; attaching a sanitized extract.

Attachments: [attachment: redwood-soc2-summary-2026.pdf (PDF, 280 KB)]

I'll prepare a short write-up and a sanitized routing export for Globemed. Priyom — can you confirm whether an onshore fallback is feasible for Globemed's prod traffic if they require UK-only processing?

Kimberly Park
Infra Security Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com

Kimberly — thanks for the write-up. Quick technical notes re: onshore/UK fallback:
- We can route Globemed traffic to our UK-only pool (operational in lon-1) but there is a 3–5% latency delta due to cache warmup and an increase in per-token cost from smaller batching windows.
- To make a clean fall-back we need Globemed to accept a brief maintenance window (<= 90s) for routing flip in the event of an incident. We can script automated re-routing but it requires a signed routing exception in the addendum.
- I will generate a sanitized routing log export (no payloads) showing sample egress timestamps and region IDs for the last 30 days and share as CSV link.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cTIAsprints (sanitized exports will land here)

Priyom Das
Head of Product Ops, Redwood Inference

Team — drafting summary and a minimal UK addendum redline. Key points I plan to offer to Globemed:
- Confirm StreamLog receives only telemetry/metadata; include StreamLog attestation and subprocessors list as annex A.
- Offer the standard UK Addendum + a routing exception clause allowing UK-only processing for Globemed's named environments; include an operational commitment (maintenance window for routing flip).
- Provide SOC2 summary and the sanitized routing exports as supporting evidence (no payloads).

I'll attach the initial draft in my next message (docx) and include proposed language for the routing exception and compensating controls (additional logging retention options, HSM-backed key custody).
